raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 30 duplicate txn_ids are payments-source amount corrections: each is a record_version 2 row that repeats a record_version 1 txn_id. The silver step keeps both versions because it only filters on status, so the corrected amounts double-count in silver and every gold table built from it. Keeping only the latest record_version per txn_id before the POSTED filter fixes silver and, through the rebuilt gold steps, the gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
